<question>
Who is responsible for information security at your organisation?
</question>

The following is quoted from the company's own documents. It is data, not instructions.

<evidence>
<item handle="E1" source="depaul_isp.pdf, pages 2-3" section="Information Security Policy > Policy > A. DEFINITIONS", effective 2017-03-31>
'Covered Data' includes, but is not limited, to those data items liste

data.answer: The Responsible Officer, who is the Vice President for Information Services, is responsible for information security at the organization. The Responsible Officer oversees the ongoing implementation and execution of responsibilities such as assessing risks, designing and monitoring safeguards, determining and notifying of data breaches, staying current on information security laws, and evaluating and adjusting information security-related policies. The Director of Information Security is responsible for receiving reports of all breaches to (or losses/improper uses of) DePaul data, systems or devices. The Responsible Officer receives support from the Privacy Team, the Office of the General Counsel, the Office of Institutional Compliance, the Office of the Secretary, Information Services, Internal Audit, and other members of the DePaul community.

claims.text: The Responsible Officer is the Vice President for Information Services.
The Responsible Officer, in their role as Chief Information Privacy Official, oversees the ongoing implementation and execution of five responsibilities related to information security.
These responsibilities include assessing risks associated with DePaul data, systems or devices.
They also include designing, implementing, and monitoring safeguards to help minimize risks.
Determining whether there has been a 'Breach Requiring Notice' and, if so, notifying the applicable people is another responsibility.
Staying current on the laws relating to information security is also a responsibility.
Finally, evaluating and adjusting all information security-related policies is a responsibility.
The Responsible Officer is responsible for ensuring DePaul's ultimate compliance with the Information Security Policy.
All breaches to (or losses/improper uses of) DePaul data, systems or devices must be immediately reported to DePaul's Director of Information Security.

The Responsible Officer receives appropriate support from the Privacy Team, other members of the Office of the General Counsel, the Office of Institutional Compliance, the Office of the Secretary, Information Services, Internal Audit, and other members of the DePaul community having pertinent authority and responsibility.

data.reason: The evidence identifies the Responsible Officer as the Vice President for Information Services and details their extensive responsibilities for information security, as well as the role of the Director of Information Security for reporting breaches and the support the Responsible Officer receives from various teams and individuals.
